info.title: CivicOps municipal API
info.description: Implemented CivicOps endpoint contracts, explicit role policies and tenant-bound projections. File storage is single-instance; PostgreSQL is shared transactional storage. Explicit demo uses synthetic data and simulated integrations. Provider/AMD/municipal production validation is owner-pending. OIDC establishes an opaque cookie session; issuer access/ID tokens are not CivicOps service bearer credentials.

contact.name: Deployment owner; production support contact pending

servers.description: Current deployment origin; resident municipality paths may use /m/{slug} as a prefix.

get.description: Permission: supervise. Municipality-local crew app. Crew devices have crew:self access plus sos-trigger for their own alert; they cannot dispatch or read the control-room queue. Photos are always stripped of metadata server-side. POST /sos records a real control-room alert and accepts no coordinates. Cookie writes require CSRF. Municipality binding and service-account scope are enforced server-side. EXPLICIT DEMO compatibility is enabled only by CIVICOPS_DEMO_MODE=true.

Location requires a current device-owned bounded shift, current explicit revocable purpose consent and visible indicator; off-shift/revoked buffered uploads are rejected and audited without coordinates. Own raw histories are retained1–30days and automatically purged. Crew completion records a worker report; a dispatcher resolves the case through the existing human-review workflow. Photos are always stripped of metadata server-side. POST /sos records a real control-room alert and accepts no coordinates. Cookie writes require CSRF. Municipality binding and service-account scope are enforced server-side. EXPLICIT DEMO compatibility is enabled only by CIVICOPS_DEMO_MODE=true.

Location requires a current device-owned bounded shift, current explicit revocable purpose consent and visible indicator; off-shift/revoked buffered uploads are rejected and audited without coordinates. Own raw histories are retained1–30days and automatically purged. Crew completion records a worker report; a dispatcher resolves the case through the existing human-review workflow. Photos are always stripped of metadata server-side. POST /sos records a real control-room alert and accepts no coordinates. Cookie writes require CSRF. Municipality binding and service-account scope are enforced server-side. EXPLICIT DEMO compatibility is enabled only by CIVICOPS_DEMO_MODE=true.

crew-location-request.title: Consent-gated on-shift crew location batch
crew-location-request.description: Current device-owned shift and current purpose consent are verified server-side, including on retries. No off-shift, withdrawn, biometric or covert collection is accepted. Batch points must share a UTC date, arrive in capture order at the tenant interval (one-second timer tolerance), and satisfy its accuracy bound.

map-feature-collection.description: Tenant-authorized RFC 7946 structured municipal features. Layers pages are capped at 500, wards at 64; heat cells aggregate incidents/hazards only. Coordinates are longitude/latitude in the regional SA envelope. No raw person locations, imagery or identification data.

map-hazard-request.description: Object/situation event reviewed by a named authorized supervisor. All fields required, including cameraId:null when absent. Unknown fields, imagery, identification and person scoring are rejected. Event must be within the default seven-day retention window and not in the future.

repeatedFalseAlarmReview.description: True only when a named human should review another false alarm from the same requester. It is not a score, count or penalty.

sos-alert.description: Resident contacts are represented by a tenant-bound hash. This contract contains no raw contact, imagery, biometric or person-risk field.

sos-create-request.title: Synthetic SOS trigger

sos-inbound-request.title: Synthetic SMS or WhatsApp SOS keyword

sos-location-request.title: Active SOS follow-up location

sos-queue.title: Control-room SOS queue

oidc.description: Owner-specific discovery placeholder. Set CIVICOPS_OIDC_AUTHORITY to the trusted HTTPS issuer; start /auth/login for authorization code + PKCE. Successful login establishes staffSession. Issuer bearer tokens are not accepted by this API.

staffSession.name: __Host-CivicOps-Session
staffSession.description: Opaque server-side staff session from OIDC or administrator bootstrap login. Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax. Cookie writes require X-CivicOps-CSRF. Process-local sessions expire on restart.

serviceAccountBearer.description: Municipality-bound administrator-issued opaque service token, stored only as a hash. Permission scopes: tools:invoke, zendesk:webhook, training:read, training:write, incidents:read, incidents:write, audit:read, integrations:write. Expiry/revocation/rotation checked per request; token appears once in create/rotate response.

crewDeviceBearer.description: Supervisor-paired or trusted native-OIDC opaque crew device token, hashed at rest, at most8hours and immediately revocable. Bound to one municipality/worker/crew; only crew:self routes allowed. Never accepts caller-selected worker identity or police/dispatch approval.

dispatcherBearer.description: Legacy default-tenant bootstrap dispatcher token; configured named identity is resolved on the server. Prefer OIDC staffSession for staff access.

trainingBearer.description: Separate CIVICOPS_TRAINING_CLIENTS bootstrap token; cannot access incident/provider-tool routes. Default-tenant only; use scoped municipality-bound service accounts for other tenants.

elevenLabsToolSecret.name: X-CivicOps-Tool-Secret
elevenLabsToolSecret.description: Legacy default-tenant resident-tool shared secret. Prefer serviceAccountBearer with tools:invoke.

zendeskWebhookSignature.name: X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature
zendeskWebhookSignature.description: Base64 HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + exact raw request bytes, with configured ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Timestamp header is mandatory; maximum replay age five minutes. A service bearer does not replace raw-body signature verification.

elevenLabsWebhookSignature.name: ElevenLabs-Signature
elevenLabsWebhookSignature.description: t=unix-seconds,v0=hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + '.' + exact raw request bytes using ELEVENLABS_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Maximum replay age five minutes. Signature verification is mandatory.

channelIngressSignature.name: X-CivicOps-Signature
channelIngressSignature.description: Trusted authenticated relay HMAC-SHA256 envelope in addition to provider-native authentication. Timestamp, nonce, provider, configured tenant public URL and exact body are bound; durable replay receipts required. Not a vendor-native header.

sosIngressSignature.name: X-CivicOps-SOS-Signature
sosIngressSignature.description: Simulated SMS/WhatsApp/USSD ingress HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + exact JSON body, paired with X-CivicOps-SOS-Timestamp. The demo bypasses external delivery; production requires an aggregator contract and replay-bounded timestamp.
